title: Adobe Research’s new, intuitive paradigm for generative video honored at UIST 2026
subtitle: Newly published work from Adobe researchers has been honored with a Best Paper Honorable Mention Award at this year’s ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology (UIST). The paper, A Text-Native Interface for Generative Video Authoring, describes an experimental tool, and a new paradigm, that allows users to create and refine generative videos using text, all within a single document.
